items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: Joe Barrett did get you together a couple of times

ctx.x: Two clarinets and a cornet. Sharky on the cornet. Two clarinets. Two clarinets. He had a wonderful ear. It's a marvelous instrumentation. You'd be surprised.

I've often wanted to get these two guys together, Ram and Burke and Harry. Well, Joe Barrett did get you together a couple of times, but then you did it for three. Yeah, but it wasn't done in that way. It wasn't done in the right way. This has got to be rehearsed, what Harry does.
